message.content: {"caption":"Line chart comparing pass rates across iterations for three greedy patch-selection strategies and three flat Trace2Skill baselines.","description":"The x-axis is Iteration, from 0 to 10; the y-axis is SpreadsheetBench-Vrf pass rate (%) with labeled ticks at 35, 45, 55, and 65. The legend identifies Greedy +Success as a blue solid line with hollow circles, Greedy +Error as an orange solid line with square markers, and Greedy +Combined as a green solid line with triangle markers. The greedy success series starts near 48%, falls to about 37% at iteration 3, then generally recovers to about 55% by iteration 10. Greedy +Error starts near 48%, rises to the low-to-mid 60s, and stays around that level. Greedy +Combined also starts near 48%, peaks around 65% at iteration 2, then fluctuates mostly around 58–62%. The dashed horizontal Trace2Skill baselines are blue for +Success (about 66%), orange for +Error (about 65.5%), and green for +Combined (about 70%).
